title: Metadata publication and key rotation
acceptance: Publication is serialized in the Durable Object and metadata_version only increases
Key statuses active, retired and revoked behave as in ATA-01:07
Rotation and rollback both publish content with a higher metadata_version
A key status change or metadata publication does not take effect if its audit record cannot be committed
findings: Replaces AUT-044. Correction: rolling back by republishing earlier metadata would be rejected by clients (they reject a lower metadata_version).
